Implied volatility surfaces: SPX & NDX index options

CS 418, Team UIC Traders. SVI fits to end-of-day OPRA closing quotes, Oct 2025 to Jun 2026.

Surface: total variance interpolated linearly in maturity between fitted expiries (7 to 180 days). Smiles drawn only over each expiry's quoted strike range. Realized vol = volatility of the index over the following 30 calendar days (blank for the last month).
